title: claude-sub: carry a quota-stopped job's commits into its redispatch
description: A claude-sub job whose subscription ran out mid-job is now collected as transient MidJob infrastructure (PR fixing finding 2): answerInfrastructure rejects it and redispatches at the same tier. But a long job may have committed real work before the quota ran out, and the infrastructure path disposes the attempt without carrying that work (disposeRejectedWork/rejectionCarries is skipped because answerInfrastructure returns its refusal first). Carry a MidJob infrastructure failure's commits into the next try the way a missing-result rejection's are carried, so hours of subscription work are not redone on Workers AI. Test: a quotaRanOutFor collect with commits on its branch; the redispatched try starts from them.
